name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Oil Prices Surge After Iran and U.S. Trade Strikes
changes.summary: The renewed hostilities posed fresh risks to ships seeking to navigate the Strait of Hormuz.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: The U.S. strikes Iran for a third weekend as Iran retaliates by hitting Gulf nations, Sen. Lindsey Graham died Saturday at the age of 71, Congress returns from recess this week.

changes.title: US and Iran Trade Strikes as Ceasefire Deal Efforts Unravel
changes.summary: The United States and Iran traded even more attacks, some of the most intense in months, as the already fragile ceasefire continues to unravel. On Sunday, President Donald Trump told Kristen Welker on Meet the Press that the Strait of Hormuz remains open – even though Iran said earlier that it was closed. NBC’s Matt Br.

changes.title: Strait of Hormuz Ship Traffic Falls to Lowest Point in a Month After Strikes
changes.summary: Shipping activity plummeted after Iran attacked a ship, setting off U.S. strikes. Little crude oil is being transported through the critical waterway.

changes.title: Trump suggests he has left a standing order to attack Iran if it assassinates him. But Vance would make the call
changes.summary: President Trump is suggesting he has left standing orders for the U.S. military to destroy Iran " at levels they've never seen before " if Tehran follows through on its long-standing threats to kill him.

changes.title: Will Oil Prices Rise as the US-Iran Truce Frays? The Answer Lies With China.
changes.summary: For decades, OPEC influenced the market by how much oil it produced. But China, the largest importer, is demonstrating its remarkable power over prices.

changes.title: Oil surges more than 9% after Trump reimposes Iran blockade
changes.summary: The price of oil jumped after President Trump declared on social media that the U.S. would be “reimbursed” for helping ships transit the Strait of Hormuz.

changes.title: UK says Iran-backed group behind arson and vandalism attacks on Jewish community
changes.summary: The U.K. government says a proxy group backed by Iran is responsible for recent arson and vandalism attacks on Jewish sites in Britain.

changes.title: Yemen’s Fragile Peace in Peril as Houthis Accuse Saudi Arabia of Bombing
changes.summary: The Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen accused Saudi Arabia of striking Yemen’s main international airport in a dispute over an Iranian plane that tried to land in the capital, Sana.

changes.title: Inside Israel’s Secret Operation to Install Ahmadinejad, Iran’s Former President, as Leader
changes.summary: The yearslong effort to groom the former Iranian president as an intelligence asset culminated in a dramatic effort to take him to an Israeli safe house in the early days of the war. But the plan fell apart.
